body.heading: Settle and look
paragraphs: On a clear evening, lie on the blanket with your adult and let your eyes get used to the dark.
The longer you look, the more stars appear. They were there all along.

body.heading: Find your shapes
paragraphs: Look for shapes: a spoon, a kite, a wonky W. There is no wrong answer; they are your shapes.
Point with your arm and describe your shape so your adult can find it too.

takeaway: People long ago joined the stars into pictures, and you can join them your own way.
materials: A torch with a red cover (optional)
safetyNotes: Only look at the night sky, outside with your adult in a safe, familiar place; never look at the Sun.
screenFreeExtension: Draw your favourite star shape on black paper with a white crayon.
